name: game-gdd-author
description: > Guides section-by-section writing of a game design document that doubles as an agent-verifiable spec: pillars, core loop, MDA-tagged systems with pass/fail acceptance criteria and tuning knobs, scope tiers and an AI-use policy. Use for "write my GDD", "create a game design document", "turn my concept into a spec". Not for critiquing an existing GDD (use game-design-review).
author: AlterLab-IEU
